name: Develop21
description:
Develop21 tools help Claude use the job search connectors you find here. 

Claude uses Develop21 tools to plan & run your job search on many job search boards, consolidating results and giving you a short-list. Claude can then manage the opportunities, working with you in a clear process to create job applications.

Claude builds your Career Profile from your resume, adding what it knows about you as it learns more. It loads this profile every time you use the tools - so you get thread continuity. 

Claude saves your data on Develop21, loading and updating it as described in the tools. Everything is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) - this is your data so we do not sell it or use it to show you ads.

Claude uses Develop21 tools to build precise queries on each MCP job search board - Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Dice, JobDataLake, JobGet/Snagajob, Aquent, FoundRole, SonicJobs, Reed.co.uk and Jobtome.

LinkedIn & HiringCafe - Develop21 tools help Claude create job search links for you to click and capture with the Develop21 Chrome browser extension. You can also forward your LinkedIn & Indeed job alert emails to your Develop21 address. 

You capture job descriptions directly from MCP connectors, using the browser extension, by pasting a URL into chat, or by pasting descriptions that you cannot open any other way.

From capture, Claude reviews your fit for each job, honestly in both directions. Are you right for the job, and is the job right for you? If you decide to apply, Claude helps you tailor your resume and draft a cover letter in the employer's language. Truthful reframing only, never invented experience. 

The Develop21 Dashboard at mcp.develop21.ai/account helps you track all your information and drive things forward. 

Your account is created when you first connect. Free within storage limits - Develop21 Storage at $4.95/month removes them. 

Develop21 fills the context vacuum, so your AI doesn't have to guess - every question is answered at develop21.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Develop21 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Develop21 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.develop21.ai/api/d21-6de08244/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Develop21 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Develop21 lists 23 MCP tools, including develop21_create_profile, develop21_delete_document, develop21_delete_job, develop21_draft_cover_letter, develop21_favourite_job, develop21_get_document, develop21_get_job, develop21_get_profile, develop21_help, develop21_log_application, develop21_ping, and develop21_rate_response.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Develop21?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Develop21 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Develop21 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Develop21 is developed by Develop21 LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
